narrative: On October 27, 2023, at approximately 1610 hours, officers were dispatched to Westside Park near the intersection of Second Street and Meadow Avenue in the Harbor District following multiple reports of a public disturbance. Upon arrival, officers observed a male subject, later identified as the suspect, yelling loudly and behaving aggressively toward several park patrons. Numerous bystanders appeared alarmed and had gathered at a distance. Officers approached the suspect, issued verbal commands, and attempted to de-escalate the situation. The suspect refused to comply and continued to cause a disturbance, prompting officers to detain him. During a search incident to arrest, no weapons were located. Witnesses at the scene provided statements indicating the suspect had been confronting individuals without provocation. No injuries were reported. Officers collected video evidence from a witness and secured it for processing by the crime lab. The suspect was transported to the station without further incident.
address_block: Westside Park near the intersection of Second and Meadow

narrative: On March 23, 2023, at approximately 1643 hours, officers responded to a retail store located in the 6900 block of Madison Drive in the Cedar Grove neighborhood after being flagged down by store personnel regarding an alleged unlawful entry. Upon arrival, officers spoke with the store manager, who reported observing an unidentified individual enter a restricted employee-only area without authorization. The manager stated that the subject did not display any weapons and did not attempt to steal or damage property. Officers conducted a walkthrough of the premises and reviewed available surveillance footage, which showed the individual briefly entering the restricted area before exiting and leaving the store. No injuries were reported, and no items were found missing or damaged. Officers canvassed the area but were unable to locate the subject. Based on the investigation, no arrest was made, and the incident was determined to be unfounded. Anyone with further information is encouraged to contact the department.
address_block: a retail store in the 6900 block of Madison Drive

narrative: On January 22, 2023, at approximately 0330 hours, patrol units responded to a report of a possible impaired driver at a retail store located in the 3600 block of Cedar Drive, within the Cedar Grove neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed a vehicle parked askew in a designated space near the store entrance. Officers made contact with the driver, later identified as the suspect, who exhibited signs of impairment, including bloodshot eyes, slurred speech, and difficulty following instructions. The suspect was unable to maintain balance upon exiting the vehicle and used the door for support. Officers administered Standardized Field Sobriety Tests, all of which the suspect failed. A preliminary breath test yielded a BAC of 0.15%. The suspect admitted to recent consumption of prescription medication. No weapons were located, and no injuries were reported. Officers collected evidence, including breath test results and body-worn camera footage, for further analysis. The suspect was cited and taken into custody for DUI-Drugs.
address_block: a retail store in the 3600 block of Cedar Drive

narrative: On September 27, 2023, at approximately 12:04 AM, officers responded to a report of vehicle vandalism at a single-family residence located in the Greenfield neighborhood of Millbrook. Upon arrival, officers observed a late-model sedan parked in the driveway with extensive damage to the windshield, side mirrors, and all four doors, consistent with deliberate vandalism. The victim stated that the damage occurred sometime between 11:30 PM and 12:00 AM, and reported no known suspects or prior threats. Two witnesses residing nearby reported hearing loud banging noises and observed a hooded individual fleeing the scene on foot toward Millbrook Avenue. Officers canvassed the area but did not locate the suspect. No weapons were involved and no injuries reported. Photographs of the damage were taken and evidence collected. The estimated loss was $6,510. The case was closed pending further leads.
address_block: a single-family residence in the Greenfield neighborhood

narrative: On June 30, 2023, at approximately 11:12 AM, officers responded to the public parking lot located at 4900 Monroe Way in the Oak Park neighborhood after being flagged down by a concerned citizen. Upon arrival, officers observed the suspect seated in a parked vehicle. The reporting party and two witnesses indicated they observed the suspect handling a small plastic bag containing a substance believed to be narcotics. Officers approached the suspect, who appeared nervous and attempted to conceal the bag under the driver’s seat. Officers conducted a consensual search of the vehicle and recovered a clear plastic baggie containing a white powdery substance consistent with cocaine. The suspect was detained and admitted to possessing the substance for personal use. Witnesses provided written statements corroborating the events. No weapons were involved, and no injuries were reported. The suspect was cited for drug possession and released at the scene. The narcotics were collected as evidence and submitted for laboratory analysis.
address_block: the public parking lot at 4900 Monroe Way

narrative: On January 11, 2023, at approximately 8:10 AM, officers were dispatched to Industrial Park Park near the intersection of Madison and Lincoln in the Lakefront neighborhood following reports of a disturbance involving disorderly conduct. Upon arrival, officers observed an adult male suspect shouting profanities and behaving aggressively toward several park patrons. The suspect continued to yell despite repeated verbal commands to cease his disruptive behavior. Witnesses on scene reported that the suspect had been verbally harassing passersby for several minutes prior to police arrival but did not physically assault anyone. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. Officers detained the suspect and conducted a preliminary investigation, including obtaining witness statements and verifying identities. The suspect was issued a citation for disorderly conduct and placed under arrest without incident. There was no property loss. The case was referred to detectives for follow-up investigation.
address_block: Industrial Park Park near the intersection of Madison and Lincoln

narrative: On May 21, 2023, at approximately 1:28 AM, officers patrolling the University District were flagged down by a resident in the 5200 block of Harbor Road regarding a possible burglary in progress at a local apartment complex. Upon arrival, officers observed a first-floor window to the leasing office ajar with no visible signs of forced entry, indicating it had likely been left unlocked. A walkthrough revealed several file cabinets within the office area had been rummaged through, with papers and files scattered on the floor, suggesting a targeted search. The victim, an apartment manager, reported missing items including various power tools, a flat-screen television, and a collection of rare coins, with a combined estimated loss of $11,643. Officers canvassed the area and located a male suspect matching witness descriptions nearby, in possession of some of the stolen property. The suspect was arrested without incident. No injuries were reported. Evidence, including surveillance footage and physical items, was collected. The case was referred to detectives for further investigation.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 5200 block of Harbor Road

narrative: On December 18, 2024, at approximately 1440 hours, officers were flagged down by a resident near the entrance of an apartment complex located in the 3400 block of Adams Road, Old Town, regarding a disturbance involving excessive noise. Upon arrival, officers could clearly hear loud music and shouting coming from a second-floor unit. Officers made contact with the occupant, identified as the suspect, who appeared agitated and was uncooperative with requests to lower the volume. Multiple residents in the vicinity stated that the noise had been ongoing for over an hour and disrupted their ability to conduct daily activities. After repeated verbal warnings and the suspect’s continued refusal to comply, officers placed the suspect under arrest for disturbing the peace. No injuries were reported and no weapons were involved. Surveillance footage from building management has been secured as evidence and is being reviewed for further documentation.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 3400 block of Adams Road

narrative: On February 17, 2024, at approximately 12:09 PM, officers on patrol in the Industrial Park neighborhood were flagged down by a park patron near the intersection of Maple and Madison in South Valley Park. The reporting party stated that an individual was observed displaying a firearm inside a parked vehicle, described as a dark-colored sedan. Officers made contact with the suspect, who was seated in the driver’s seat. Upon approach, officers observed a handgun resting on the center console. The suspect was cooperative and provided identification. A records check revealed the suspect did not possess a valid permit for firearm ownership or carry. The weapon was safely secured by officers, and no injuries were reported. The suspect was cited for illegal possession of a weapon and released at the scene. The firearm was entered into evidence. No witnesses reported seeing threats or injuries. The case was assigned to detectives for further investigation.
address_block: South Valley Park near the intersection of Maple and Madison

narrative: On March 7, 2023, at approximately 4:55 AM, officers were dispatched to Oak Park Park near the intersection of Monroe and Harbor in the Midtown neighborhood regarding a reported motorcycle theft. Upon arrival, officers made contact with the victim, who stated that their motorcycle, valued at approximately $38,536, had been taken from the parking area. The victim reported that a spare key was hidden on the motorcycle and believed that the suspect located and used it to facilitate the theft. Officers canvassed the area and obtained surveillance footage from a nearby business, which captured a male suspect approaching the motorcycle, locating the key, and riding away. The suspect was subsequently located a short distance away with the stolen motorcycle and taken into custody without incident. No injuries were reported. The suspect was cited and arrested at the scene. The recovered motorcycle was processed for evidence and returned to the victim. Further investigation is ongoing.
address_block: Oak Park Park near the intersection of Monroe and Harbor

narrative: On February 19, 2024, at approximately 2052 hours, officers responded to a reported strong-arm robbery at Lakefront Park near the intersection of Forest and River in Midtown. Upon arrival, officers located the victim inside a nearby establishment, visibly shaken and suffering a minor contusion to the left forearm. The victim stated that while entering their vehicle parked in the lot, an unknown male suspect approached the driver’s door, brandished a blunt object resembling a metal pipe, and demanded the victim exit the vehicle. The suspect forcibly removed the victim from the car and took a purse, phone, and wallet, with an estimated loss totaling $1069. Officers canvassed the area and interviewed three witnesses, who reported seeing the suspect fleeing eastbound on Forest Street. Consistent witness statements were documented. Officers collected security footage from nearby businesses and photographed the victim’s injuries. No arrest was made at the scene, and the case was closed pending further investigative leads.
address_block: Lakefront Park near the intersection of Forest and River

narrative: On July 21, 2023, at approximately 6:39 AM, patrol units were dispatched to the Best Buy electronics store located in the Greenfield Shopping Center, Old Town, in response to a report of a possible DUI involving alcohol. Upon arrival, officers observed a vehicle parked askew in the lot, engine running, with a single adult occupant in the driver’s seat. Contact was made with the driver, who exhibited slurred speech, bloodshot eyes, and the odor of an alcoholic beverage emanating from their person. The driver was unable to coherently state their origin or intended destination. Officers administered standardized field sobriety tests, including the Horizontal Gaze Nystagmus, Walk and Turn, and One Leg Stand, all of which the subject failed. A preliminary breath test was conducted, yielding a BAC of 0.1%. The driver was placed under arrest for DUI Alcohol without incident. No injuries were reported. Surveillance footage from the store was secured as evidence and is pending review. The vehicle was towed from the scene.
address_block: the Best Buy electronics store in the Greenfield Shopping Center

narrative: On April 18, 2024, at approximately 8:43 AM, officers were flagged down by a resident in the 200 block of Harbor Road, Westside neighborhood, who reported a possible unlawful entry into an apartment complex. Upon arrival, officers made contact with the reporting party, who stated they observed an unknown individual attempting to open several apartment doors within the complex. Officers conducted a systematic check of the premises and did not locate any subjects matching the description provided. There were no signs of forced entry, property damage, or items missing from any apartment units. Officers spoke with additional residents, none of whom observed any suspicious activity or unfamiliar persons in the area. Management provided access to surveillance footage, which was collected and is being reviewed for further investigation. No injuries, weapons, or losses were reported. Based on the information available at the scene, the incident was determined to be unfounded.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 200 block of Harbor Road

narrative: On February 26, 2024, at approximately 1:42 AM, officers responded to the 8500 block of Lake Avenue in the North Hills neighborhood regarding a report of criminal trespass. Upon arrival, officers observed the suspect, described as an adult male, standing on private property near the rear entrance of a residence. The property owner, identified as the reporting party, stated that the suspect had entered the fenced yard without permission and refused to leave when confronted. Officers made contact with the suspect, who acknowledged he did not reside at the location and had no legitimate reason for being on the property. The suspect was placed under arrest for criminal trespass without incident. No weapons were involved and no injuries were reported. The scene was photographed, and officers documented the owner’s statement. The suspect was transported to the local detention facility. The case was assigned to detectives for further investigation.
address_block: the 8500 block of Lake Avenue

narrative: On February 18, 2024, at approximately 11:40 AM, officers were dispatched to University District Park, near the intersection of Lincoln Avenue and First Street in the North Hills neighborhood, in response to a report of a weapons offense involving illegal possession. Upon arrival, officers observed a male subject, later identified as the suspect, seated on a bench near the park’s north entrance. Two witnesses on scene reported seeing the suspect remove a handgun from his backpack and display it briefly before concealing it again. Officers detained the suspect without incident and conducted a search, locating an unregistered handgun inside the suspect’s backpack. The suspect was placed under arrest for illegal possession of a firearm. Both witnesses provided consistent statements and agreed to provide written statements. No injuries were reported and no shots were fired. The weapon was collected as evidence and submitted for further analysis. The suspect was transported to the station for booking.
address_block: University District Park near the intersection of Lincoln and First

narrative: On December 3, 2024, at approximately 2:03 AM, officers were flagged down by the victim at Cedar Grove Park near the intersection of Harbor and First in the Millbrook neighborhood. The victim reported that unknown suspect(s) had used their personal identifying information to open fraudulent credit accounts, resulting in unauthorized purchases totaling approximately $10,383. The victim stated they became aware of the theft after receiving alerts from their financial institution earlier that day. Officers obtained a preliminary statement from the victim and observed no signs of physical injury. Surveillance footage from park cameras was secured and is currently under review to identify possible suspects or vehicles involved. No weapons were involved, and no arrests have been made at this time. Officers advised the victim to monitor their accounts and provided information on further steps to protect their identity. The case remains open pending additional investigative leads.
address_block: Cedar Grove Park near the intersection of Harbor and First

narrative: On March 20, 2023, at approximately 0007 hours, officers responded to a reported petty theft at the intersection of Valley Street and Harbor Avenue in the Highland neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim standing near a parked vehicle and a male suspect being detained by a security guard. The victim reported that the suspect had removed items valued at approximately $10,677 from the vehicle without permission. Two witnesses at the scene provided consistent accounts, stating they observed the suspect open the vehicle’s rear door and remove several electronics and personal property before attempting to flee on foot. Officers recovered the stolen items nearby and confirmed ownership with the victim. The suspect was identified through his driver's license and issued a citation for petty theft. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. The suspect was released at the scene following processing. Officers documented the incident, photographed the evidence, and completed witness statements for further investigation.
address_block: the intersection of Valley Street and Harbor Avenue

narrative: On November 9, 2023, at approximately 1524 hours, officers responded to a reported carjacking at the Wells Fargo bank located at 7600 Oak Boulevard in the Riverside neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim, a 23-year-old female, seated on the curb near the bank entrance, displaying minor abrasions to her right arm and reporting pain in her left wrist. The victim stated she had exited her vehicle in the parking lot when an unknown suspect approached, forcibly pushed her aside, and entered her vehicle. The suspect then drove off in the victim’s car, a silver sedan, striking her as he fled the scene. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses; one bystander indicated seeing a male suspect in dark clothing leaving in the vehicle at high speed. EMS was called to assess the victim’s injuries. No suspect was located, and evidence including surveillance footage was requested from bank management. The loss was estimated at $3,323. The case was determined to be unfounded after further investigation.
address_block: the Wells Fargo bank located at 7600 Oak Boulevard

narrative: On July 14, 2023, at approximately 6:50 AM, officers were dispatched to the auto parts store at 700 Third Boulevard in the Eastgate neighborhood regarding a reported check fraud incident. Upon arrival, officers contacted store management, who advised that a male suspect had attempted to purchase auto parts valued at $77,453 using multiple fraudulent checks. Store employees became suspicious due to irregularities in the checks and notified police while detaining the suspect on-site. Officers interviewed witnesses, obtained surveillance footage, and recovered the fraudulent checks as evidence. The suspect was taken into custody without incident; no injuries were reported and no weapons were involved. The suspect declined to make a statement. All relevant evidence was collected, and the case was assigned to detectives for further investigation.
address_block: the auto parts store located at 700 Third Boulevard

narrative: On July 25, 2023, at approximately 4:14 AM, officers were dispatched to a retail store located in the 9100 block of Maple Drive, Westside neighborhood, regarding a weapons offense involving brandishing. The suspect raised the object in a threatening manner but did not make physical contact or cause injury. The suspect then exited the store and fled on foot in an unknown direction. Officers canvassed the area but were unable to locate the suspect. No injuries were reported, and no property loss occurred. Surveillance footage was reviewed and preserved for investigative purposes. The incident was documented, and the case has been referred to detectives for follow-up.
address_block: a retail store in the 9100 block of Maple Drive

narrative: On October 9, 2024, at approximately 6:21 AM, officers responded to a report of vandalism at the intersection of Maple Street and Lincoln Avenue in the Eastgate neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed extensive damage to the exterior of a commercial building, including multiple shattered windows and spray-painted graffiti on the north-facing wall. The property owner, present at the scene, estimated the total loss at $9,413 and stated the damage occurred overnight. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses and spoke with a nearby resident who reported hearing loud noises around 5:40 AM but did not observe any suspects. No injuries were reported and no weapons were involved. Officers documented the scene with photographs and collected paint samples and broken glass fragments for analysis. The suspect was not present; however, based on evidence found at the scene, officers issued a citation for property destruction. All collected evidence will be forwarded to the crime lab for further processing.
address_block: the intersection of Maple Street and Lincoln Avenue

narrative: On November 24, 2023, at approximately 1713 hours, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Jefferson Street and Forest Avenue in the Greenfield neighborhood regarding reports of a public disturbance. Upon arrival, officers observed a male subject in the roadway, shouting profanities and causing vehicular and pedestrian traffic to stop. Several bystanders were present, and multiple witnesses reported the subject had been yelling aggressively for several minutes. Officers made verbal contact and instructed the subject to leave the roadway; however, the subject refused to comply and continued his disruptive behavior. Officers subsequently placed the subject under arrest for disorderly conduct without incident. No injuries were reported at the scene, and no weapons were observed or found on the subject. Surveillance footage from a nearby business was secured for evidence and is under review. No property damage or financial loss was reported. The subject was transported to the station for processing.
address_block: the intersection of Jefferson Street and Forest Avenue

narrative: On November 19, 2023, at approximately 12:48 PM, officers responded to a reported unlawful entry at a jewelry store located within the Midtown Shopping Center in the Cedar Grove neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers made contact with store employees who stated that an unknown individual entered the store through a rear employee-only entrance, which was marked as restricted. Witnesses described the suspect as a male, approximately 30-40 years old, medium build, wearing a gray hoodie and jeans. The individual remained inside for less than five minutes and did not interact with staff or access display cases. Surveillance footage was reviewed on scene, confirming the suspect entered the restricted area but did not remove any property. Witness statements were consistent, and no injuries or losses were reported. Officers advised staff on securing restricted access points and completed the investigation at the scene. The incident was documented, and the case was closed with no arrest made.
address_block: the jewelry store in the Midtown Shopping Center

narrative: On March 17, 2023, at approximately 5:55 AM, officers were dispatched to an apartment complex located in the 3100 block of Forest Road, Harbor District, in response to a report of a subject brandishing a weapon. Officers canvassed the area but the suspect had left prior to arrival; no injuries were reported. Witnesses provided a description of the suspect as a male, medium build, wearing a dark jacket and jeans. Officers searched the immediate vicinity for weapons and collected surveillance footage from nearby cameras. Physical evidence, including video recordings and witness statements, was secured and submitted to the crime lab for further analysis. The investigation remains open and no arrests have been made at this time.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 3100 block of Forest Road

narrative: On May 20, 2024, at approximately 3:33 AM, officers responded to a retail store located in the 9500 block of Maple Drive in the Cedar Grove neighborhood after being flagged down by store personnel regarding a theft in progress. Upon arrival, officers contacted the store manager, who reported that a male suspect had concealed multiple electronic items, valued at approximately $12,908, and attempted to exit the premises without paying. Officers detained the suspect near the store’s exit and conducted a search, recovering the stolen merchandise within the suspect’s backpack. The suspect was placed under arrest without incident. The store manager provided a written statement, and the recovered items were logged as evidence. The investigation is ongoing.
address_block: a retail store in the 9500 block of Maple Drive

narrative: On November 5, 2023, at approximately 1604 hours, officers responded to a reported criminal trespass at the intersection of Park Street and River Avenue in the Sunset Heights neighborhood. The reporting party described the individual as a male, approximately 30-40 years old, wearing a gray hoodie and blue jeans. Officers searched the immediate vicinity but did not locate any persons matching the description. No damage to property or signs of forced entry were observed, and no witnesses reported seeing the individual enter any restricted areas. The incident was determined to be unfounded at this time. Officers advised the reporting party to contact the department if the individual returns or further suspicious activity occurs. No arrests were made, and no injuries or losses were reported.
address_block: the intersection of Park Street and River Avenue

The suspect appeared agitated but did not possess any weapons. Officers conducted a field interview, during which the suspect admitted to being upset over a personal matter but denied intent to harm anyone. No injuries were reported by witnesses or involved parties. Surveillance footage from a nearby business was secured for further review. Based on the observed behavior and statements from witnesses, the suspect was cited for disorderly conduct and released at the scene. No arrest was made, and there was no reported property loss. Officers cleared the area after ensuring the situation had deescalated.

Officers initiated contact and detained one adult male, identified as the primary suspect, who was found in possession of several small bags containing a substance believed to be narcotics. No weapons were found on scene. The residence was secured, and surveillance footage from exterior cameras was collected for evidentiary review. No injuries were reported. The suspect was advised of his rights and transported to the station for booking. Statements were obtained from two witnesses present, both of whom described observing frequent short-term visits to the residence consistent with drug activity. All evidence was logged and will be submitted for analysis.

narrative: On April 15, 2024, at approximately 4:48 AM, patrol officers responded to a report of domestic violence at a residence located on the 4700 block of Harbor Avenue, in the North Hills neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim, an adult female, seated on the front porch, visibly distressed and complaining of pain to her ribs and difficulty breathing. The victim stated that during a verbal argument, the suspect—her cohabitating partner—struck her in the torso with a blunt household object before fleeing the scene on foot. Officers conducted a thorough canvass of the immediate area and interviewed neighbors; no additional witnesses to the assault were located. Medics were summoned to assess the victim’s injuries, and she was transported to a local hospital for further evaluation. Officers collected photographic evidence of the victim’s injuries and documented the scene. The suspect was not located; the investigation remains open pending further leads.
address_block: the 4700 block of Harbor Avenue

narrative: On November 26, 2023, at approximately 2128 hours, officers were dispatched to the 700 block of Jefferson Avenue, Downtown neighborhood, regarding a reported vehicle burglary. Officers made entry and found the interior of the residence ransacked; several pieces of furniture in the living room were overturned. The victim reported that multiple items had been stolen, including electronics, assorted jewelry, and an undetermined amount of cash, with total estimated loss valued at $8,819. No injuries were reported and no weapons were involved. Officers conducted a canvass of neighboring residences but were unable to locate any witnesses or surveillance footage. The victim was provided with a case number and advised on follow-up procedures. The investigation was closed pending further leads.
address_block: the 700 block of Jefferson Avenue

narrative: On May 19, 2023, at approximately 1539 hours, officers responded to a reported weapons discharge in the 700 block of Valley Avenue, located in the Downtown neighborhood. Officers canvassed the area and located the suspect, who was cooperative and admitted to striking the pole with a wooden bat in frustration. No injuries were reported and no property loss occurred. Officers documented the scene, photographed the pole, and collected statements from witnesses. The suspect was cited on scene for weapons-related offense and released. The case was forwarded to detectives for follow-up investigation.
address_block: the 700 block of Valley Avenue

narrative: On June 16, 2024, at approximately 4:19 AM, officers were dispatched to the 1000 block of Second Street in the Riverside neighborhood in response to a reported noise disturbance. Officers made contact with the occupant, identified as the primary resident, who was cooperative and acknowledged hosting a small gathering. The resident was informed of the noise ordinance and advised to lower the volume. Officers issued a citation for violation of the municipal noise ordinance. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. The occupant was advised regarding possible further enforcement action should additional complaints occur. Officers cleared the scene at approximately 4:35 AM. No arrests were made. The case has been assigned to detectives for follow-up investigation to determine if there is a pattern of disturbances at this location.
address_block: the 1000 block of Second Street

narrative: On November 1, 2023, at approximately 1:11 AM, officers were dispatched to an apartment complex in the 300 block of Main Road, Lakefront neighborhood, in response to a reported vehicle burglary and possible residential break-in. The victim, who was present, reported that several items were missing: a 55-inch television, multiple power tools, and a set of collectible coins, with an estimated total loss of $7,237. No injuries were reported and no weapons were involved. Officers canvassed the area and located a male suspect hiding between parked vehicles in the complex lot and detained him without incident. The suspect matched the description seen on surveillance footage, which was obtained from apartment security and is being reviewed as evidence. The suspect was transported to the station for booking. address_block: the intersection of Meadow Street and Harbor Avenue

A witness, the on-site security guard, stated he observed the suspect climbing over the fence and immediately notified police. Officers collected security footage and documented the scene. The suspect was arrested for trespassing and transported for booking. There was no reported property loss or damage. The case was assigned to detectives for follow-up investigation.
address_block: the public parking lot at 6400 River Way

The victim reported noticing suspicious account activity after parking their vehicle earlier in the evening and believed their identity was stolen via documents left in the vehicle. Officers canvassed the area for surveillance cameras and collected electronic evidence, including bank statements and transaction records provided by the victim. No injuries were reported and no suspects were present at the scene. Witnesses in the vicinity were interviewed, but no one observed any suspicious persons or activity during the relevant time. The case was closed pending further leads and the collected evidence was submitted to the crime lab for processing.
address_block: the public parking lot at 2800 Monroe Way

narrative: On January 27, 2023, at approximately 2:55 PM, patrol units responded to a report of possible drug distribution at University District Park near the intersection of Harbor Avenue and Lincoln Street in the Riverside neighborhood. Surveillance footage from nearby city cameras was secured and reviewed by responding officers, but no activity consistent with drug distribution was observed during the relevant timeframe. No suspects were identified, no narcotics were located, and no arrests were made. The incident was documented as unfounded and the case was closed pending further information. No injuries or weapons were reported.
address_block: University District Park near the intersection of Harbor and Lincoln

narrative: On March 19, 2024, at approximately 1550 hours, officers were flagged down by an employee at an apartment complex located in the 3400 block of Cedar Road, Downtown, regarding a reported commercial burglary. Upon arrival, officers observed the garage door to the business office had been forcibly pried open, with pry marks consistent with the use of a crowbar. Inside the office, file cabinets appeared to have been rummaged through in a targeted manner. The reporting party stated that computer equipment, a cash register containing approximately $12,000 in currency, and various inventory items valued at $890 were missing. narrative: On April 24, 2024, at approximately 1737 hours, officers were flagged down by a reporting party in the public parking lot at 2300 River Way, Eastgate, regarding a reported strong-arm robbery. The victim reported relinquishing a wallet, cellphone, and wristwatch, with an estimated combined loss of $5,715. The suspects fled on foot eastbound through the lot. The victim sustained a minor laceration to his left hand, reportedly from being pushed, and was evaluated by EMS on scene. Officers observed no visible injuries on the victim; however, he reported significant pain to his jaw and declined medical treatment at that time. A witness, identified as a neighbor who heard shouting and saw the suspect running from the residence, provided a brief description of the individual. Officers canvassed the area for the suspect and recovered the metal flashlight from the living room as evidence. The victim was advised of his rights and provided a statement. The driver, later identified as the suspect, exhibited slurred speech and bloodshot eyes and had difficulty producing a driver’s license when requested. Officers detected a strong odor of alcoholic beverage emanating from the suspect’s breath and vehicle interior. The suspect failed all standardized field sobriety tests administered on scene. The driver refused standardized field sobriety tests when requested but consented to a preliminary breath test, which registered a blood alcohol concentration of 0.23%. Interviews were conducted with two witnesses, both store employees, who reported that the subject had stumbled into the store and appeared confused. No injuries or property damage were reported. narrative: On March 8, 2024, at approximately 1656 hours, officers were dispatched to the 7100 block of Third Avenue in the Bayshore neighborhood in response to a reported noise disturbance. The vehicle owner, the victim, stated that the car was intact when last seen at approximately 11:00 PM on March 14, 2023. address_block: the public parking lot at 6800 River Way

narrative: On December 31, 2023, at approximately 10:59 AM, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Elm Street and Main Avenue in the Downtown neighborhood following a report of suspected check fraud. Upon arrival, officers made contact with the reporting party, an employee of a local financial institution, who stated that a male suspect had attempted to cash a check in the amount of $67,399, which was later determined to be fraudulent. The suspect, described as a middle-aged male wearing a dark jacket and jeans, was still present at the scene and was detained for questioning. The suspect provided conflicting statements regarding the origin of the check. Officers collected the check as evidence and interviewed witnesses, including bank staff who verified the check’s fraudulent nature. The suspect was cited on scene and taken into custody without incident. No injuries or weapons were reported. Detectives were assigned to conduct further investigation into the source of the fraudulent check and potential involvement of additional parties.
address_block: the intersection of Elm Street and Main Avenue

narrative: On September 20, 2023, at approximately 1:46 PM, officers were dispatched to the Walgreens pharmacy located in the South Valley Shopping Center, Millbrook neighborhood, in response to a reported shoplifting incident. Upon arrival, officers spoke with store employees who stated that an adult suspect entered the store, selected multiple items including electronics, cosmetics, and over-the-counter medications, and concealed them in a large tote bag. The suspect then exited the premises without attempting payment. Employees provided a physical description of the suspect and shared surveillance footage, which captured the suspect’s actions. Witnesses corroborated the sequence of events, indicating no injuries occurred and no weapons were involved. Officers documented the stolen merchandise, which totaled an estimated loss of $3,932. The suspect was located nearby, issued a citation for theft, and released on scene. All witness statements, video evidence, and inventory records were collected for follow-up investigation.
address_block: the Walgreens pharmacy in the South Valley Shopping Center

narrative: On August 12, 2023, at approximately 1616 hours, officers were dispatched to the 1400 block of Harbor Avenue in the University District regarding a reported simple assault. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim, an adult individual, seated on the sidewalk and holding their head with visible blood present. The victim sustained a laceration approximately two inches in length to the forehead and reported dizziness. Seattle Fire Department personnel were requested and provided medical aid on scene. The victim stated they had been struck on the head with an unknown blunt object by an unidentified individual after a verbal altercation. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses and potential video surveillance but were unable to locate any suspects or witnesses at the time. No weapon was recovered. Due to insufficient evidence and conflicting accounts, the incident was determined to be unfounded at this time. The victim was advised to contact the department if further information became available.
address_block: the 1400 block of Harbor Avenue

narrative: On November 27, 2024, at approximately 2:57 AM, officers were flagged down by a store employee outside a retail store in the 7100 block of Maple Drive, Riverside neighborhood, regarding a weapons offense involving brandishing. The employee reported that a male suspect, described as approximately 35 years old, medium build, wearing a black jacket and blue jeans, entered the store and became verbally aggressive with staff over a transaction dispute. During the confrontation, the suspect produced a metallic object, later identified as a collapsible baton, and waved it in a threatening manner toward the employees but did not physically strike anyone. Officers detained the suspect without incident inside the store. No injuries were reported. The collapsible baton was recovered as evidence. Surveillance footage capturing the incident was secured for further review. Witness statements were obtained from two employees present. The suspect was arrested on scene for brandishing a weapon.
address_block: a retail store in the 7100 block of Maple Drive

narrative: On June 5, 2023, at approximately 1509 hours, officers were flagged down by a neighbor on the 6600 block of Pine Street, Midtown, who reported an ongoing domestic dispute involving a firearm. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim, an adult female, seated on the front steps with a visible laceration to her forehead and blood on her clothing. The victim stated she was assaulted by her domestic partner during an argument inside their residence. She reported the suspect brandished a handgun, threatened her, and struck her with the firearm before fleeing on foot in an unknown direction prior to officers’ arrival. Medical personnel were requested and transported the victim to a local hospital for treatment. Officers canvassed the area but did not locate the suspect. A witness provided a description consistent with the victim’s account. Photographs of the victim’s injuries and the scene were taken. The case was cited and referred to detectives for further investigation.
address_block: the 6600 block of Pine Street

narrative: On August 29, 2023, at approximately 1322 hours, officers were flagged down by the victim at the intersection of Lake Street and First Avenue, located in the Industrial Park neighborhood, regarding a reported grand theft. The victim stated that upon returning to their parked commercial vehicle, they discovered that several high-value tools and electronic equipment, valued at approximately $8,560, had been removed from the secured cargo area without their consent. The victim reported last seeing the items intact at approximately 1200 hours. Officers inspected the vehicle and observed signs of forced entry, including damage to the rear lock mechanism. Officers conducted a canvass of the immediate area and made contact with nearby business employees; however, no additional witnesses were identified and no surveillance cameras were observed in the immediate vicinity. The victim was provided with a case number and advised on follow-up procedures. This incident remains open for further investigation.
address_block: the intersection of Lake Street and First Avenue

narrative: On July 26, 2023, at approximately 2115 hours, officers were flagged down by a resident in front of a single-family residence located in the Downtown neighborhood of Greenfield regarding a weapons offense. The reporting party stated that an unknown male suspect approached the residence and brandished a blunt object, described as a metal pipe, while shouting threats. The suspect then fled on foot northbound through the neighborhood prior to officers’ arrival. Officers canvassed the area but did not locate the suspect. No injuries were reported and no property damage was observed. Surveillance cameras from the residence and adjacent homes captured footage of the incident. Officers secured and cataloged the footage as evidence. The victim provided a description of the suspect as a male, approximately 5'10", medium build, wearing a dark hoodie and jeans. The investigation is closed pending further leads.
address_block: a single-family residence in the Downtown neighborhood

narrative: On July 3, 2023, at approximately 5:29 PM, officers responded to a report of a possible DUI alcohol incident at an apartment complex in the 4700 block of Main Road, located in the Industrial Park neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed a vehicle parked erratically in a designated parking area. Contact was made with the driver, an adult male, who exhibited difficulty maintaining balance while exiting the vehicle, relying heavily on the door for support. Officers detected a strong odor of alcoholic beverage emanating from the driver's breath and noted slurred speech and bloodshot eyes. Standardized field sobriety tests were administered; the driver failed the horizontal gaze nystagmus, walk-and-turn, and one-leg stand tests. A preliminary breath test indicated a blood alcohol concentration of 0.16%. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. The driver was cited for DUI alcohol and released at the scene. The investigation is ongoing; anyone with information is asked to contact the department.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 4700 block of Main Road

narrative: On November 17, 2024, at approximately 2209 hours, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Harbor Street and Pine Avenue in the Bayshore neighborhood regarding a report of suspected drug paraphernalia. Upon arrival, officers canvassed the immediate area and observed a glass pipe commonly associated with narcotics use lying on the sidewalk near the northeast corner of the intersection. No individuals were observed in the vicinity, and no witnesses approached officers at the scene. The paraphernalia appeared to be unused and did not contain any visible residue. Officers photographed the item in situ before collecting it as evidence, following standard protocols. The glass pipe was properly packaged and submitted to the crime lab for further analysis. Officers conducted an area check for additional items or parties associated with the paraphernalia but found none. No arrests were made, no injuries were reported, and no further evidence was located. The incident is classified as unfounded pending lab results.
address_block: the intersection of Harbor Street and Pine Avenue

narrative: On June 8, 2023, at approximately 1703 hours, officers were dispatched to a reported domestic violence incident at a residence located in the 9100 block of Pine Avenue, Millbrook neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers made contact with the victim, an adult female, who displayed visible bruising on her arms and neck. The victim stated that during a verbal argument, the suspect, described as her adult male partner, became physically aggressive and reportedly brandished a kitchen knife, threatening her before fleeing the scene on foot prior to police arrival. Officers conducted an area search but were unable to locate the suspect. Two neighbors, who identified themselves as witnesses, stated they heard yelling and observed the suspect leaving the residence in a hurried manner. Paramedics assessed the victim’s injuries, which were non-life-threatening. No weapon was recovered at the scene. Based on the investigation and conflicting evidence, the incident was determined to be unfounded at this time. No arrests were made.
address_block: the 9100 block of Pine Avenue

narrative: On July 25, 2023, at approximately 0433 hours, officers responded to the 8700 block of Main Avenue in the Sunset Heights neighborhood following a report of a vehicle burglary. Upon arrival, officers observed a sedan parked in front of the residence with the front driver’s side door lock showing visible pry marks consistent with attempted forced entry. The vehicle’s interior was undisturbed. Officers made contact with the reporting party, who stated that upon returning home, they discovered the front door of their residence ajar and the interior in disarray, with several pieces of furniture overturned in the living room. The victim reported the theft of multiple power tools, one 55-inch television, and a collection of rare coins, with a combined estimated value of $3,500. Officers canvassed the area and interviewed two neighbors who both reported hearing loud noises around 0400 hours but did not observe any suspects or vehicles leaving the scene. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. Officers processed the scene for fingerprints and photographed evidence. After further investigation, it was determined there was no forced entry to the vehicle, and the incident was classified as unfounded.
address_block: the 8700 block of Main Avenue

narrative: On January 9, 2024, at approximately 8:09 PM, patrol units responded to a reported residential burglary at an apartment complex in the 7100 block of Washington Road, located in the Midtown neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers observed the rear door to the apartment had been forcibly opened, with visible pry marks around the door frame. The interior was ransacked, with furniture overturned and contents of drawers strewn across the living room floor. The victim, who returned home and discovered the break-in, reported that several items were missing, including power tools, a flat-screen television, and a collection of collectible coins, with an estimated total loss of $1,561. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses and reviewed available exterior surveillance footage, but no suspects were observed entering or exiting the premises during the relevant timeframe. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. Crime scene technicians processed the scene for latent prints and other physical evidence. The investigation remains ongoing.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 7100 block of Washington Road

narrative: On April 18, 2023, at approximately 10:06 AM, officers were flagged down by a resident in the 1100 block of Second Street, Millbrook neighborhood, regarding an attempted auto theft. Upon arrival, officers observed a late-model sedan parked curbside with the driver-side window shattered, evidenced by broken glass scattered on the pavement. The victim stated that the vehicle, valued at approximately $37,897, had been parked overnight and was discovered with visible damage but had not been moved from its original location. No injuries were reported and no suspects were observed at the scene. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses; a neighbor reported hearing glass breaking around 10:00 AM but did not see any individuals. Officers collected physical evidence, including glass fragments and possible fingerprints from the vehicle's door handle. The scene was documented with photographs. The investigation remains open, and residents with information are encouraged to contact the police department.
address_block: the 1100 block of Second Street

narrative: On March 30, 2023, at approximately 8:26 AM, officers were dispatched to a single-family residence located in the Riverside neighborhood, Industrial Park, regarding a report of vehicle vandalism. Upon arrival, officers observed a late-model sedan parked in the driveway with extensive damage, including multiple shattered windows, deep scratches on all sides, and punctured tires. The victim reported hearing loud noises outside at approximately 8:15 AM, and upon investigation, observed the suspect actively damaging the vehicle with a metal tool. The suspect, described as male, mid-30s, wearing a dark jacket and jeans, was still on scene when officers arrived and was immediately detained without incident. No injuries were reported. The victim provided a written statement, and officers photographed the damage, estimating the loss at $5,111. A canvass of the neighborhood was conducted, but no additional witnesses were located. The suspect was cited and placed under arrest for vandalism.
address_block: a single-family residence in the Riverside neighborhood

narrative: On November 30, 2023, at approximately 0430 hours, officers responded to a report of an attempted auto theft at the Home Depot located at 5000 Lake Boulevard in the Midtown neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers were flagged down by a witness in the parking lot who stated that two unknown subjects were observed attempting to push-start a parked vehicle, described as a white pickup truck. The witness reported that after several minutes, the subjects succeeded in starting the vehicle and were seen driving away eastbound on Lake Boulevard. Officers conducted an area search but were unable to locate the vehicle or suspects. The victim was contacted and confirmed that the vehicle, valued at approximately $20,330, had not been authorized for use and was missing from its last known location. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. Surveillance footage from Home Depot was requested for review. The investigation remains ongoing; individuals with information are encouraged to contact the police department.
address_block: the Home Depot located at 5000 Lake Boulevard

narrative: On December 16, 2023, at approximately 1:01 AM, patrol units responded to a report of vandalism at a single-family residence located in the Riverside neighborhood of Lakefront. Upon arrival, officers observed extensive graffiti in black and red spray paint covering the front exterior wall, garage door, and mailbox of the residence. The homeowner, identified as the victim, stated that the damage occurred between 12:30 AM and 1:00 AM, and estimated the cost of repairs at $10,901. Officers canvassed the area and interviewed two neighbors who witnessed a group of three unidentified individuals wearing dark clothing fleeing the scene on foot shortly after the incident. No injuries were reported, and no weapons were involved. Officers photographed the damage, collected paint samples, and checked nearby surveillance cameras for footage. The investigation was closed due to lack of suspect identification at the time, and the victim was advised about further reporting options.
address_block: a single-family residence in the Riverside neighborhood

narrative: On September 9, 2023, at approximately 1811 hours, officers were dispatched to an apartment complex located in the 3400 block of Main Road, Midtown, in response to a reported weapons offense involving brandishing of a firearm. Upon arrival, officers canvassed the area and made contact with the reporting party, who stated that an unknown male had allegedly pointed a handgun at another individual in the parking lot before fleeing on foot. Officers interviewed multiple witnesses in the vicinity; none were able to corroborate the account, and no victim was located. A thorough search of the complex and surrounding area yielded no evidence of a firearm or suspicious activity. Surveillance footage was reviewed and revealed no indication of the incident as described. No injuries were reported, and there was no loss of property. Based on available information and lack of corroborating evidence, the incident was determined to be unfounded. The case was referred to detectives for further follow-up.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 3400 block of Main Road

narrative: On March 23, 2024, at approximately 11:45 AM, officers responded to a report of a weapons offense involving the brandishing of a blunt object at the Target store located at 9700 Maple Boulevard in the Highland neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers were met by store employees who stated that a male individual had allegedly displayed a metal pipe while arguing with another customer near the electronics section. Employees reported that the suspect waved the object in a threatening manner but did not make physical contact or verbal threats. Officers canvassed the area and located both parties; the alleged suspect denied brandishing the object and stated he was carrying a metal pipe for a home project. Surveillance footage was reviewed, showing the suspect holding the object but not making overtly aggressive gestures. No injuries were reported, and no arrests were made. The item was photographed and documented as evidence. The incident was determined to be unfounded based on the available information.
address_block: the Target store located at 9700 Maple Boulevard

narrative: On July 23, 2024, at approximately 0347 hours, officers responded to a report of a weapons offense at an apartment complex located in the 800 block of Second Road, Highland neighborhood. Upon arrival, officers contacted two adult witnesses outside Building C, both visibly shaken. Witnesses stated that an unknown male suspect, described as approximately 25-35 years old, medium build, wearing a dark hoodie and jeans, approached them in the parking lot. The suspect brandished a black handgun, pointing it in their direction while verbally threatening them before fleeing on foot eastbound through the complex. Officers conducted a canvass of the area but did not locate the suspect. No injuries were reported, and no property was taken. Witnesses provided written statements and the area was checked for surveillance cameras. The case remains open pending further investigation.
address_block: an apartment complex in the 800 block of Second Road

narrative: On December 21, 2024, at approximately 0324 hours, officers were dispatched to Harbor District Park near the intersection of Washington and Hill in the Parkview neighborhood regarding a reported carjacking. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim standing near a parked vehicle, visibly shaken and exhibiting signs of distress, but not requiring medical attention. The victim stated that while sitting in their vehicle, two unidentified suspects approached on foot and blocked the vehicle’s exit. One suspect, described as a male wearing dark clothing and a hooded sweatshirt, produced a blunt object resembling a metal pipe, while the second suspect, also in dark attire, brandished a knife. The suspects ordered the victim to exit the vehicle and demanded all personal belongings. Fearing for their safety, the victim complied, surrendering their wallet, cell phone, and vehicle. The suspects entered the vehicle and fled eastbound on Washington. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses and secured surveillance footage from nearby businesses. The estimated loss, including the vehicle and property, was $8,098. Investigation ongoing.
address_block: Harbor District Park near the intersection of Washington and Hill

narrative: On March 11, 2024, at approximately 10:14 AM, officers were dispatched to the Wells Fargo bank located in the Eastgate Shopping Center, Old Town neighborhood, in response to a reported carjacking. Upon arrival, officers observed the victim, an adult female, standing near the entrance and visibly shaken. The victim reported that as she was entering her vehicle, a late-model dark sedan rapidly approached and stopped adjacent to her car. The suspect, described as a male in dark clothing and a hooded sweatshirt, exited the sedan, approached the driver’s side, and brandished a blunt object resembling a metal pipe, demanding the victim exit the vehicle. Fearing for her safety, the victim complied, sustaining minor bruising to her left arm during the incident. The suspect then entered the victim’s vehicle and fled northbound out of the shopping center. Officers canvassed the area for witnesses and obtained surveillance footage from the bank, which captured the suspect’s actions and vehicle. No arrests were made at the scene. Estimated loss, including the vehicle and personal property, totaled $10,380.
address_block: the Wells Fargo bank in the Eastgate Shopping Center
